full_judgment: 11. Opposing the Rule, Mr Habibullah, learned Senior Counsel, submits that as the defendants violated the order of injunction by entering into the suit land of 'Kha'-schedule by breaking the eastern wall, the learned Joint District Judge was justified to order for local investigation to ascertain whether or not there was any such violation and there is no reason for the defendants to become aggrieved. He cites the cases of Amulya Kumar Samaddar and another vs Annada Charan Dab and others, 37 CWN 143. where local inspection was granted to ascertain as to whether or not certain structures were old or newly constructed; Mahmud Ibne Abbas vs Begum Momtaz Hossain and another 45 DLR 421, where local inspection was ordered to ascertain whether there was any house on the suit land; and the case reported in AIR 1989 Orissa 214.
